latestCommit.message:
Local assets by default; audio; GDScript and three.js (#54)

* Local assets by default through godogen_assets; paid APIs in api.md; audio

asset-gen/SKILL.md is a TL;DR of godogen_assets' local generators (images,
3D, rigging, Kimodo moves, lip-sync, sound effects, voice) that links to its
READMEs instead of repeating them, plus what the game side needs: -o into the
project, one GPU job at a time, a gen3d face budget, .ogg for Bevy, the asset
manifest. publish.sh writes the checkout recorded in the git-ignored
.godogen_assets into the skill; without it the skill says none and every
asset goes to the paid APIs.

asset-gen/api.md holds the paid path, read only when a local part is missing
or can't make the asset: Gemini / Grok images, sprite video, Tripo 3D, and
audio - Gemini TTS voice acting (asset_gen.py speech) and Lyria music
(asset_gen.py music, loop_audio.py for seamless loops).

motion.md keeps the game side of add-moves output (authored poses as spec
constraints, root motion and impact timing from rootmotion.json, prop gates)
and points to godogen_assets for generation. KIMODO_HOME is gone; setup.md
points to the godogen_assets setup, and API keys and the Tripo CLI are
optional.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Gemini 3.8 TTS; designed character voices

asset_gen.py speech runs gemini-3.8-flash-tts through the Interactions API.
The text is a verbatim transcript: whole-line delivery goes in --style,
moments in inline <tags>, and --speakers takes "Name (style): text" lines
staged in conversational mode (sent raw, since the SDK's typed speech_config
drops "mode"). Output is WAV from the API; cost comes from reported usage at
the introductory prices, doubled from 2027-01-01.

asset_gen.py voice design creates a persistent voice_... from a short
description and saves its in-character audition; voice list browses the
voice library, voice delete frees a slot.

api.md covers casting (library voices for realistic humans, designed voices
for everything else), tags-only barks, two-speaker clips, the refusal of
child voices, and the user's own replicated voice. google-genai>=2.25.

latestCommit.message:
[MCP] Document running several editors at once, bump to `3.1.2`

Every editor serves MCP on port 8000 by default, so a second editor can't
bind it and its client silently reaches the first editor. setup.md gains a
step 5: one fixed port per workspace (ini or -ModelContextProtocolPort),
a matching .mcp.json with the proxy installed, sessions started per
workspace. operations.md gains "Identify the editor": read the instance
metadata the engine now returns on initialize / server/discover, a pid
check for the session's own connection, and the port-owner fallback for
older builds.
